- The screen stays on while a video is playing, and can dim and lock again normally once it's paused.
- Picture-in-picture: leaving the app while a video plays (home button or gesture) keeps the video playing in a floating window, without chat. The window has play/pause controls. Closing the window pauses playback.
- Leaving the app while a video is playing without picture-in-picture now pauses it instead of continuing in the background.

Installs over v1.1.0 directly. If you're still on v1.0.0, uninstall it first; it was signed with a different key.
